## Low Chinese Opening

With **R9**, Black is not enclosing the bottom right corner but playing on a somewhat larger scale. The idea behind the opening is that White at some time will be forced to invade somewhere in the framework that Black builds on the right, after which Black will use the attack on the white group to turn another part of it into territory.

Source: [Sensei's library](https://senseis.xmp.net/?ChineseFuseki)
